item.title: It Was a Call from God: The Horror of the Turpin Family
item.description: In January 2018, 17-year-old Jordan Turpin escaped her California home and called 911, exposing years of captivity endured by 13 siblings. Explore the Turpin family case, the secrets David and Louise kept behind closed doors and the courageous decision that finally brought their children to freedom.

item.title: No One Thought a 14-Year-Old Would Do This!
item.description: Colleen Ritzer stayed after school to help a student. She never made it home. Surveillance footage revealed 14-year-old Philip Chism following her through Danvers High School. Explore the evidence behind the 2013 case that devastated a Massachusetts community and the teacher whose kindness lives on.

item.title: They Left Her at a Lake, Then Went to Buy Cigars | Melody Hoffman
item.description: Melody Hoffman, 20, was killed in Iowa in 2024. Dakota Van Patten helped McKinley Louisma carry out the crime, then took selfies wearing her glasses. Explore the evidence, investigation and trials behind this disturbing true crime case. What do his actions reveal? Subscribe for true crime coverage.
